Runtime Composition and APIs
|-- Deployment entry: vite.config.ts -> diagramApi() -> createBackend()
|   |-- Roots and storage
|   |   |-- Project: NEW_DIAGRAM_PROJECT_ROOT or two directories above Vite root
|   |   |-- Data directory: NEW_DIAGRAMS_DIR or .diagrams
|   |   |-- Agent source root: Vite root
|   |   `-- Watcher ignores storage and .diagrams* directories to avoid reloads on data writes
|   |-- Capability switches: global Symbol.for('new-diagram.<name>-enabled') === true
|   |   |-- http -> agent HTTP writes, socket canvas writes and agent-context uploads
|   |   |-- pi   -> passed to model integrations; enables diff workflows and push integration
|   |   `-- lsp  -> construct ProjectLanguageService; otherwise inject undefined
|   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_DOMAIN -> domain profile only if recognized as built-in
|   `-- NEW_DIAGRAM_ALLOWED_HOSTS -> optional comma-separated preview allowlist
|-- Composition root: src/server/app/bootstrap.ts
|   |-- Shared persistence and source access [S]
|   |   |-- DiagramStore(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory) -> storeRoot for concrete stores
|   |   |-- corpusAccess = provider + document-line reader + corpus discovery
|   |   |-- CoreApplication <- DiagramStore + corpusAccess
|   |   `-- FileAgentContextSources
|   |       |-- sourceId starts with repo- -> resolve repository checkout as git-worktree corpus
|   |       `-- Other source -> require initialized project -> resolveDiagramSource().binding().corpus
|   |-- Runtime selection: NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT === 'fake'
|   |   |-- true  -> fake local chat, mapping, diagram edit, compaction, eval and comparison runtimes
|   |   `-- false -> CodexLocalChat, PiMapping, PiDiagramEdit, PiFileCompaction,
|   |               AgentContextEval and CodexComparison runtimes
|   |-- Canvas and agent services [A]
|   |   |-- MappingDiagramService <- [S] + project/profile + WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge [B]
|   |   |-- AgentContextLibrary <- FileAgentContextRepository + context sources [S]
|   |   |-- AgentContextService <- shared context library
|   |   |-- FileDiagramAgentContextStore <- storeRoot + context sources [S]
|   |   |-- CanvasApiProjection shared by live-canvas and agent-session services
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService <- bridge connection list + context dispatch + contexts + projection
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |       `-- [B] + diagrams + store + QuickJsAgentRuntime + changes + edit runtime
|   |           + contexts + projection + diagram-context store
|   |-- Chat
|   |   |-- LocalChatService <- store + corpusAccess + selected local-chat runtime + source root
|   |   `-- AgentChatService [C]
|   |       |-- StdioCodexConnection + FileChatStore + source root
|   |       |-- LiveCanvasService + shared bridge [B] + context library [A]
|   |       `-- ChatDiagramTools(agent) + MappingChatMcpBinding(agent, process.cwd())
|   |-- Change and push workflows
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService <- DiagramChangeSessionStore + store + bridge [B]
|   |   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService <- changes + agent [A] + PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   |   `-- FileDiffSessionRunStore + prompts + repository source reader; enabled by pi
|   |   `-- PushIntegrationService <- FilePushIntegrationStore + GitPushSource(store.repositories)
|   |       `-- DiffSessionWorkflowService + pi enablement
|   |-- Workspace, comparisons and evaluations
|   |   |-- MappingWorkspaceService <- store + MappingWorkspaceStore + diagram-context store
|   |   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog <- shared store [S]
|   |   |-- CompareSessionService <- workspace + FileCompareSessionStore + catalog + store
|   |   |-- EvalReferenceService <- reference/group JSON stores + shared store
|   |   |-- EvalPromptService <- prompt/snapshot JSON stores + shared store + references
|   |   |-- EvalRunService [E]
|   |   |   |-- Compare sessions + workspace + store + context library + prompts + catalog
|   |   |   |-- Eval-run JSON store + selected eval runtime + FileRollUpRunStore
|   |   |   |-- LayoutTemplateService + layout-template JSON store
|   |   |   |-- FileCanvasTimeline
|   |   |   `-- ReferenceGenerationService <- session JSON store + agent chat [C] + [E]
|   |   |-- ComparisonGenerationService <- compare sessions + FileComparisonRunStore
|   |   |   `-- Selected comparison runtime
|   |   |-- JudgementService <- judgement JSON store + compare sessions + comparison service/stores
|   |   |-- ExperimentService <- experiment JSON store + [E] + store + context library
|   |   `-- Explicit callbacks connect generation history and evaluation outputs
|   |       |-- AgentChat.observeGenerations -> EvalRun.recordLegacy; reconciliation errors logged
|   |       |-- Eval replay/cancel -> AgentChat.rerunAlternatives / cancelGeneration
|   |       |-- Eval readChangeSession -> ChangeSessionService.get
|   |       |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog.snapshot -> EvalRun.outputSnapshot
|   |       `-- Eval deleteContextComparisons -> ComparisonGenerationService.deleteContextOutputs
|   |-- Additional route dependencies
|   |   |-- ProjectSourceService <- store + corpusAccess + optional language service
|   |   |-- ProjectCatalogService <- store
|   |   |-- SelectionService <- store + selected mapping runtime + source root
|   |   `-- FileCompactionService <- core + selected runtime + FileCompactionStore
|   |       `-- Prompt loader + agent-settings resolver
|   `-- Return routes.core, routes.mapping, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows,
|       pushIntegrations and dispose()
|-- Vite transport boundary: src/server/app/vitePlugin.ts
|   |-- One backend constructed by diagramApi(); attach to dev or preview server
|   |   |-- Install HTTP middleware
|   |   `-- If httpServer exists, attach live-canvas sockets to shared LiveCanvasService
|   |-- HTTP dispatch, in order
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal path boundaries -> next middleware
|   |   |-- Classified agent mutation + http disabled + no x-canvas-chat-binding header
|   |   |   `-- 403 with code HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |   |-- Not /api/<known namespace> -> 404; /internal has no route dispatch here
|   |   `-- /api/core/... or /api/mapping/... -> corresponding injected route handler
|   `-- Handler failure -> transport response
|       |-- Headers already sent -> error event; end response if still open
|       `-- Headers not sent -> JSON {error}, with status
|           |-- RequestTooLarge -> 413
|           |-- ProjectDiagramConflict or ApplicationError conflict -> 409
|           |-- ApplicationError invalid-input -> 400; binary-source -> 415
|           |-- ApplicationError lsp-disabled / ai-disabled / storage-unavailable -> 503
|           |   `-- Disabled LSP/AI also include LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
|           `-- Other errors -> 400
|-- Core API: src/server/routes/core/routes.ts; paths below /api/core/project
|   |-- GET files, GET source -> ProjectSourceService
|   |-- POST definitions -> ensure definitions enabled -> source.definitions(body, signal)
|   |   `-- Response closes before completion -> abort; finally remove close listener
|   |-- POST projections -> ProjectCatalogService.saveProjection
|   |-- GET corpus-compactions -> require project -> catalog.compactions
|   |-- POST corpus-compactions -> require project -> CoreApplication.upsertProjectFileCompaction; 201
|   |-- GET representations -> CoreApplication.projectRepresentations
|   |   `-- history=current selects current; otherwise all
|   `-- Unsupported methods on matched endpoints -> 405; unmatched route -> 404
|-- Mapping API: src/server/routes/mapping/routes.ts; paths below /api/mapping
|   |-- Delegated route families require their injected optional services
|   |   |-- generated-canvases[/...] -> generated-canvas handler using EvalRunService
|   |   |-- evals/... -> eval handler using runs + prompts + references
|   |   |-- comparison-runs[/...] -> comparison-generation handler
|   |   |-- compare-sessions[/...] -> compare-session handler
|   |   |-- agent-chat/... -> agent-chat handler
|   |   |-- integrations/... -> push handler + NEW_DIAGRAM_PUSH_TOKEN
|   |   |-- workflows/diff-session-create* -> diff-workflow handler
|   |   |-- live/context/short -> short-context reader
|   |   |-- live/connections/:id/selection -> live-selection reader
|   |   `-- agent/... -> agent handler
|   |-- Workspace endpoints -> MappingWorkspaceService
|   |   |-- GET/POST workspace/records -> load records / apply batch
|   |   |-- POST workspace/export -> portableExport
|   |   |-- POST workspace/import-contexts -> prepareImport
|   |   |-- GET/PUT workspace -> load / save
|   |   `-- Workspace write bodies above allow 64 MiB, including history and source evidence
|   |-- compactions[/...] -> file-compaction handler; chat -> local-chat handler
|   |-- POST diagrams/publish -> publish checkpoint
|   |-- POST diagrams -> save; DELETE diagrams/:id -> delete
|   |-- POST prompt -> SelectionService.prepare -> flush NDJSON headers -> run
|   |   `-- Emit progress events -> result event -> end response
|   `-- Unknown routes -> 404; explicit endpoint method guards -> 405
|-- Shutdown ownership: HTTP server emits close
|   |-- Dispose live-canvas sockets first
|   `-- backend.dispose() calls, in source order
|       |-- comparisonRuns -> evalRuns -> agentChat -> diffSessionWorkflows
|       `-- agent -> diagramEditRuntime -> canvasBridge -> optional languageService
|           -> mappingRuntime -> chatRuntime -> compactionService
`-- Architectural guardrails: tests/architecture/dependencies.test.ts
    |-- Production imports checked across src, application, infrastructure and domain
    |   |-- domain -> domain
    |   |-- UI src -> src, domain, packages
    |   |-- application -> application, domain
    |   |-- infrastructure -> infrastructure, application, domain
    |   `-- server -> server, application, domain; bootstrap may also import infrastructure
    |-- Feature ownership: composition may connect owners; other modules may target
    |   core or their own owner, and may not import composition modules
    |-- External dependency checks constrain domain/UI Node use and application I/O/framework use
    `-- Diagram construction and prepared edits stay inside designated domain modules
        |-- constructDiagram: diagramRevisionEditor.ts or submitDiagramEdit.ts
        `-- prepareCreate / prepareEdit: diagramRevision.ts
